# Flav

> Flav is an iPhone app that saves recipes from TikTok, Instagram Reels and recipe web pages. You share a cooking video to Flav from the iPhone share sheet, or paste its link, and Flav reads the caption and the page and saves the recipe (title, ingredients with quantities, steps in order, and the video link) to a private cookbook. Cook Mode then walks you through the steps with timers.

Key facts:

- iPhone only. Not available on Android.
- How import works: Flav reads the video's caption and page. An import usually takes a few seconds; a long caption can take about 15.
- Limit: if the recipe is only spoken in the video and not written in the caption or on the page, Flav 2.0 may return a thin or empty recipe. Flav does not read the video itself; that is planned for a later version.
- Imports are private by default.
- Cook Mode: one step at a time with timers, a Lock Screen Live Activity, and Apple Watch.
- Also: a meal plan, a grocery list built from a recipe's ingredients, and household sharing.
- Free plan: 10 AI imports a month, plus the cookbook, Cook Mode and grocery list.
- Flav+: no import limit, plus AI meal planning. $4.99 a month, $29.99 a year, or $59.99 once (lifetime), US App Store prices.
- Made by Tig Tech LLC, Austin, Texas. Support: https://flav.app/support
